claim_being_audited: The model can be certified for release now on the basis of aggregate readiness evidence, provided the packet discloses that leave-policy eligibility guidance is a named deployment context with missing evaluation coverage that must be treated as unknown rather than passed.
decision_criteria: Use aggregate readiness evidence to assess general launch support, not coverage of every named deployment context.
Treat missing evals for a named launch context as unknown, not implicitly passed.
Require disclosure, resolution, or approved risk acceptance for material limitations or evaluation gaps in named launch use cases before clean certification.
Do not accept policy compliance based only on a proposed caveat when the admissible record does not show the caveat has been implemented.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model card or certification artifact showing explicit disclosure that leave-policy eligibility guidance remains untested/unknown.
Provide any approved risk acceptance, if the gap is not being disclosed before launch.
Provide the materiality determination showing whether this named deployment context is considered a material launch use case under release policy.
Provide the planned gating condition for certification: whether launch approval is contingent on disclosure update before release.
specific_concerns: The admissible record supports launch readiness in aggregate, but it also shows a named deployment context with missing eval coverage.

The draft model card currently states there are no known HR benefits enrollment limitations because no completed test failed, which conflicts with QA's position that missing evals must be treated as unknown.
The release policy requires disclosure of material limitations or evaluation gaps for named launch use cases unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
There is no admissible evidence here that the disclosure has already been corrected in the model card or that an approved risk acceptance exists.
Because the recommended action is simply certify_model, the packet leaves an unresolved policy predicate: whether certification is conditioned on corrected disclosure before launch.
unsupported_claims: That clean certification is presently supported without additional evidence showing the model card was updated to disclose the named eval gap or that approved risk acceptance covers it.
Any implication that the absence of failed completed tests is enough to say no HR-benefits-enrollment limitations are known.
